slots.name: interrogation duration
slots.sentence: Sina said he was interrogated for about six hours and that his mobile phone was confiscated.

slots.name: identification card status
slots.sentence: Saeedi said her identification card had also been deactivated.

slots.name: Sina's age
slots.sentence: The 25-year-old said that after visiting a telecommunications center, he received a call from someone claiming to be from the Intelligence Organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IO-IRGC), who instructed him to go to a specified location to have his SIM card reconnected.

slots.name: Sorour's age
slots.sentence: Sorour, a 41-year-old translator at an official translation office in Tehran, said that after her SIM card was disconnected, she went to a location designated by the IO-IRGC, where she was interrogated for hours about her activities on Instagram and X.

slots.name: interviewees count
slots.sentence: DW spoke to three people in Iran about the issue.
